tickets.description: Hi team,  Cody and I have tried everything to organize our SharePoint folder tenant files in numerical order and nothing is working for us. We followed all the chat gpt and google gemini prompts and nothing works.   315 alderson - Documents - Tenant Reference Checks - All Documents   The folders, in the hundreds, jump all over the place. And even renaming them with 0s in front does not work.   Would yall know how to make the folders read in numerical order? We are aware of numerical gaps, but everything was fine until it got to the 100s.   Kind regards,     Chandler Riggins   Property Coordinator   Lookout Housing and Health Society   C: 1604-649-3696   www.lookoutsociety.ca         + Like Us on Facebook +   Follow Us on Twitter Follow Us on Instagram Connect with Us on LinkedIn

myComments.body:
Hi Chandler,

SharePoint will sort names as text rather than numeric values. If you would like to do it this way, you can do it as,

001, 002, 003 ... 009, 010, 011 ... 099, 100, 101 ... 147, 148.

Let me know what you think and I can think of something

Thank you!

Alex

Hi Chandler,

In SharePoint, you can also setup a column called “Files by number” which takes the Type as a number rather than text.

I already did most of the numbering but the rest I’ll leave to you so you can also get the hang of it.

Just select “IT - number view” and if you click on the “Files by number”, you can sort by ascending order.

For each blank column for the “Files by number” just type in the corresponding number and it should be good to go.
